message.content:
Review the following PR.

## PR Information
- **Title**: Use fileutil in extension test VM
- **Author**: testauthor
- **Branch**: feat/fileutil-extension → main
- **Files Changed**: 1

## PR Description
New test VM entrypoint that cleans up its socket with the retrying fileutil package.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/tests/images/sdk-api-methods-extension/vm/main.go b/tests/images/sdk-api-methods-extension/vm/main.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3333333
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/images/sdk-api-methods-extension/vm/main.go
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"log"
+	"net"
+
+	t "github.com/docker/pinata/common/pkg/fileutil"
+)
+
+const socketPath = "/run/guest-services/ext.sock"
+
+func main() {
+	if err := fileutil.RemoveAll(socketPath); err != nil {
+		log.Fatalf("failed to clean up socket: %v", err)
+	}
+	ln, _ := net.Listen("unix", socketPath)
+	_ = ln
+}
```
